question: Which of the following was the major export item from India in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Petroleum Products**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• In 2021,** petroleum products** were the major export item from India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• These are** crucial for energy needs and industrial processes.**
 
• These **include** petrol, diesel, gasoline, naphtha, jet fuel, liquified petroleum gas (LPG), and lubricants. 
 
• India ranks among the top **five exporters of refined petroleum****,** catering largely to markets like the US, UAE, China, Singapore, and the Netherlands. 
 
• India is also the **second largest refiner** in Asia after China. 
 
• After Covid-19, It **declined by 37.3 percent** year-on-year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pharmaceuticals**

 
 
• **​**With its large raw material base and skilled workforce, India is the **third - largest pharmaceutical market** by volume. 
 
• It accounts for** 20% of global generic drug exports.**
 
• It is also the country with** the largest vaccine production capacity **
 
 
 
• **Gems and Jewelry**
 
 
• **​**The gems and jewellery industry is a s**ignificant contributor to India’s exports.**
 
• It includes both **precious and semi-precious stones,** as well as gold and silver jewellery
 
• India is the **fifth largest exporter**** of gems and jewellery** with a 5.8 percent share in global exports
 
 
 
• **Automobiles**
 
 
• **​Comes under in ****Engineering goods**
 
• India’s **engineering goods exports crossed the $9-billion** mark for a single month for the first time in July 2021
 
 

a7:T
